scope: Engine-owned frozen inputs only; initial evaluation and declared local equilibrium branch; numerical verification, not a calibrated fit or physical validation

numerical_rows.comparison: Exact ordered decimal representations of binary64 values and statuses agree; no rounding tolerance. Row serialization retains Python round-trip float representations.

contention: Owner reports concurrent external MEA fits and Lithium jobs, including fits outside shared lock. No application files were consumed; per-run host load is retained with the interleaved timings.

instrumentation.run_environment: LD_PRELOAD=<absolute profile.so> EPCSAFT_PROFILE_CORE=<absolute installed _core .so> EPCSAFT_REPLAY_WHEEL=<immutable 28181e72 wheel> EPCSAFT_REPLAY_PROFILE=<profile csv>
instrumentation.condition: 28181e72 installed and verified in sole task environment first; all commands use bounded shared heavy lock; complete output tables agree with uninstrumented references

render.command: python3 tools/render-notebook.py; CSE render.sh <selected notebook.qmd or algorithms.md> --no-execute (sequential under one timeout 240 s heavy lock)
render.view_check: Rendered primary CPU ratio, load limit and exact objective match retained notebook. Standalone outputs/assets moved from source neighbors into task-owned build/companion cache; retained linked records copied there for viewing.
render.initial_failure: Quarto project discovery required generated map include before invoking the pre-render hook; presentation-only render-notebook.py populated its owner first.

notebook_review_status_refresh.change: Record independent Supported verdict; runtime and numerical rows unchanged
